# db-mcp-server Test-Pack Reference

## Registry Source

Central registry: `cloud-dog-ai-platform-standards/test-packs/REGISTRY.tsv`

There is **no service-specific test-pack** for `db-mcp-server` in the registry
(`applies_to_services = db-mcp-server` returns no row). db-mcp-server's own test suite is
maintained in-tree under `tests/` (146 collectable tests across QT/UT/ST/IT/AT). The
service consumes the two programme-wide (`applies_to_services = all`) packs below.

## No-Copy Policy

This service references central packs by `pack_id` + sha256; unpacked dump contents are
not copied into this repository. Generated fixture data created by Stream-B tests is local
test output and is removed or regenerated by the test harness.

## Fixture Materialization Policy

| generated_path | pack_id | command_or_fixture | cleanup | tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tests/fixtures/test_seed_data.py` (canonical seed) | (in-tree) | `seed_data` fixture / `POST /v1/test-data/seed` | recreated per run; gated to allowed runtime profiles | `fixtures/test_seed_data`, `UT1.22` |
| `tests/env-<backend>/` overlays | (in-tree) | `--env` plugin overlay | static, version-controlled overlays | connector `ST*`/`IT*` suites |
